description: Use this when the user asks how an episode is going, whether it is ready, or what clips were found. Returns one status for the whole pipeline (waiting_for_upload, uploading, transcribing, finding_clips, ready or failed) and, once ready, the found clips with number, ref, title, opening line, length and whether each has been cut and captioned. With no episode_id it lists recent episodes. Read the live answer from here rather than guessing how long things take. Do not use for transcripts made with transcribe_audio.

episode_id.description: From start_episode, or from this tool with no id.

name: get_episode

about.description: For a clip found by find_clips_about: the focus it was found for.

clip_id.description: The cut clip. Pass to get_job or restyle_clip.

download_url.description: The latest captioned file, when there is one.

end.description: Where it ends in the episode, mm:ss.

job_id.description: The latest cut or render job for this clip. Pass to get_job.

length.description: Length of the finished clip, mm:ss.

number.description: Position in this list. Pass to make_clips.

pieces.description: How many passages are joined to make it.

poster_url.description: A still from the cut clip.

reason.description: For a clip found by find_clips_about: how it fits the focus.

ref.description: Stable reference for this found clip, e.g. a3f9. Pass to make_clips.

start.description: Where it starts in the episode, mm:ss.

title: Get an episode
